value.rationale: A nonzero critical seed distinguishes interventions capable of inducing population-scale adoption in a linearly subcritical but globally reinforced system. The complete analytic boundary Astar(B), the exact intervention fraction, the jump size and the coalescing-fold cube-root law give a natural and reproducible benchmark for social-contagion models, beyond a routine symbolic substitution. The theorem is intentionally limited to a continuous-time homogeneous analogue and has no direct empirical/network extrapolation.
